question.problem:
Let $R=[-1,1]\times [-2,2]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y)=y-2x+10.$
Further, let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{1}=\{{x}_{0},{x}_{1},…,{x}_{m}\},\,{P}_{2}=\{{y}_{0},{y}_{1},…,{y}_{n}\},\,P={P}_{1}\times {P}_{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Given that the lower Riemann sum of $f$ with respect to $P$ is given by

$$
L(f,P)={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}\boxed{}\,Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}
$$

where $Δ{x}_{i}={x}_{i}-{x}_{i-1}$ and $Δ{y}_{j}={y}_{j}-{y}_{j-1},$ what is the missing expression in the double summation above?
question.worked_solution:
The lower Riemann sum is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}{m}_{ij}Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}\end{aligned}
$$

where ${m}_{ij}$ is the *minimum* value of $f$ in each subregion ${R}_{ij}.$ 

We consider an arbitrary subregion ${R}_{ij}$ of the partition. This subregion lies between ${x}_{i-1}$ and ${x}_{i}$ over the $x$-axis and ${y}_{i-1}$ and ${y}_{i}$ over the $y$-axis, as shown below. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14226098/assets/88ffe30ae5401e00502b35d851b216768aad69bf94236561617adf23e1ce058f.png)

Notice that:

- $f(x,y)=y-2x+10$ decreases as $x$ increases, and

- $f(x,y)=y-2x+10$ increases as $y$ increases.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14226098/assets/ffa57d3e7fed08212f12d4b9d7c2e0a4d33a3aac71c8b8a03d1a9a7364484deb.png)

As a result, the *minimum* value of $f$ in each subregion is attained when we have the *largest* possible $x$ and the *smallest* possible $y.$ This is the value at the *bottom right corner* of each subregion.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14226098/assets/c4aa9e96fe72a8fb31ab62ff7eb0695cc64992bb9433be516461915a5c92baff.png)

 

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{m}_{ij} & =f({x}_{i},{y}_{j-1})={y}_{j-1}-2{x}_{i}+10\end{aligned}
$$

for all $1\le i\le m$ and $1\le j\le n.$

Finally, the lower Riemann sum is

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({y}_{j-1}-2{x}_{i}+10)Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the missing expression is ${y}_{j-1}-2{x}_{i}+10.$
